modifications: Baked scene transforms and centered at ground in metre units; uniformly scaled to 5.38988 m US MY2024 i7 M70 reference length.
Grouped and tuned PBR finishes; preserved silhouette and exterior details.
Added eleven stable anchor nodes and Draco compression.
Removed 399 coincident triangles and 7,435 covered backing triangles and smoothed paint normals at gentle creases.
Converted source grayscale into satin silver paint, warm cabin trim, alloy, rubber and tinted glass; no BMW textures used.
Defined reversible tinted and untinted window material overrides for browser interaction; the GLB geometry remains unchanged.

Added author-built i7 and M70 xDrive rear lettering and an M70-inspired dark wheel finish using BMW MY2024 US official design references; exact badge typography, wheel design and body geometry are illustrative.
interiorDescription: Simplified artist interior: visible seats, steering wheel, dashboard, center console and rear passenger surfaces. No detailed screen UI, verified US trim, seat functions or accurate acoustic hardware. Cabin geometry is illustrative. Cabin presets use window views; close interior walkthroughs expose coarse source geometry.

limitations: Base artist model is titled 2023 i7 G70; MY2024 US i7 M70 xDrive visual treatment does not certify exact M70 geometry, trim or installed equipment.
Simplified interior; no door animation, functional displays, seat adjustment or cargo/battery internals. Cabin and equipment detail is illustrative.
Authored visualization finishes are not official BMW paint or equipment options.
No BMW website imagery, hidden configurator model or textures used.
Latest organizer guidance recorded by Troy says BMW has no 3D pack and links third-party sources. The artist-offered CC BY 4.0 remains this asset's permission basis.
A G70 click must query G70/US evidence; never reuse G60 requirements if G70 results are empty.
Cabin geometry is coarse and steering/trim layout is not certified for the US market. Camera presets deliberately frame through windows.
Source panel faceting, simplified lamps and coarse grille/cabin surfaces remain; this is artist geometry, not BMW visualization CAD.
Window tint choices are authored visual states; they do not certify BMW option availability or legal tint levels.
M70-specific front fascia, side skirts, mirror stalks, wheel design, rear diffuser and brake details are not faithfully reproduced by the source geometry; rear lettering is author-built.
